name: Atlantic hurricanes
summary: No Atlantic tropical storm or hurricane active on 16 Nov; GDACS lists only a Pacific storm
state: GDACS listed one tropical cyclone worldwide at 05:40 UTC on 16 Nov, Xavier near the Cook Islands in the South Pacific, at green level; none was active in the Atlantic, Caribbean or Gulf (GDACS). The NHC outlook could not be fetched this run, so this rating is judged from GDACS. The Atlantic season formally ends on 30 Nov.
for_you: No Atlantic storm threatens land as of 16 Nov; travellers to the Caribbean can follow the National Hurricane Center and local authorities.

sources.title: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System

why: Atlantic hurricanes hit the US Gulf coast, Caribbean and Central America — and refinery and insurance markets with them.
drivers: Sea-surface temperatures, ENSO, wind shear, season timing (Jun–Nov peak Aug–Oct).

rubric.alert: Category 3+ landfall expected within 72 hours or occurring.
rubric.watch: Tropical storm or hurricane threatening land within 5 days.
rubric.normal: No hurricane active, or none threatening land within 5 days.
